examples.text: Die Außenhülle bestand aus einer netzförmigen Struktur.
Die Blattadern erzeugen ein netzförmiges Muster.

glosses: Having the structure of a net or a network; netlike.
Of or pertaining to a reticulum.

examples.text: The fingers have a pseudosclerodermatous appearance with scleroatrophy, often with contractures and sometimes with reticulate erythema on the dorsal surface.

glosses: To distribute or move via a network.
To divide into or form a network.
Resembling or characteristic of a net, especially in having many small openings.
Having the form of a net; reticulate

examples.text: Een giraffe heeft een netvormige tekening op de vacht.
